player_prompt.intro:
Niwe Player {player_id} mu Chopsticks. Pa zamu yako, sokola mo:
  + Kukoma:  '[attack M O]'  apo M=lukasa lako (0 or 1), O=lukasa la mwenzi (0 or 1).
    - Lukasa la mwenzi lizongezeka na lukasa lako; ukika >=5, likaenda 0.
  + Kupinda:   '[split L R]'  kutawanya lukasa lako kuwa L na R (L+R = jumla yako).
Jibu na kamandi moja tu.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split afwile alyalula ifyo iminwe yenu yalepangwa.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kamandi yabipa. Tumia “[attack M O]” or “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} akapana P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: ikawa kutoka {opp_val} hadi {new_val}.
